_what: THE BOOK FOR ONE WEEK (v73.1 R-82, OG_R69_R82_SPEC): the board as sealed before the week's first kickoff, the results, the rosters as they stood at the seal with each player's model mu, the week's market — written once, never edited. pipeline/tick.book_write

market._source: ESPN's NFL scoreboard for the week + each game's core odds (DraftKings as ESPN carries it): one finished week's opening and closing lines, taken after the week (pipeline/market.week_doc); data only

seal.source: the pass's own pre-kickoff seal (tick.prekick_for), as mirrored at seals/week-N.json

results.source: ESPN weekly[N] (espn_fetch.attach_history), the pull that saw the week decided

rosters.source: ESPN mRoster as pulled for the sealed board, with sportsbook playerMu

faab.missing: the runner pulls no FAAB bid rows; ESPN's season-to-date spend is not a week's dollars (B-243)
